Q01_overall_fill_rate.sql: SELECT AGG(fill_rate) AS value FROM SAC_TEST_DB.SAC_CONFORMANCE.SAC_METRICS

Q02_gross_margin.sql: SELECT AGG(gross_margin) AS value FROM SAC_TEST_DB.SAC_CONFORMANCE.SAC_METRICS

Q03_fill_rate_by_region.sql: SELECT region, AGG(fill_rate) AS value FROM SAC_TEST_DB.SAC_CONFORMANCE.SAC_METRICS GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

Q04_monthly_fill_rate.sql: SELECT month, AGG(fill_rate) AS value FROM SAC_TEST_DB.SAC_CONFORMANCE.SAC_METRICS GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

Q05_iso_week_order_count.sql: SELECT iso_week_year, iso_week, AGG(order_count) AS value FROM SAC_TEST_DB.SAC_CONFORMANCE.SAC_METRICS WHERE order_status='Completed' GROUP BY iso_week_year, iso_week ORDER BY iso_week_year, iso_week

Q06_empty_population_revenue.sql: SELECT AGG(revenue) AS value FROM SAC_TEST_DB.SAC_CONFORMANCE.SAC_METRICS WHERE region = 'NoSuchRegion'

Q07_inventory_turnover.sql: SELECT AGG(inventory_turnover) AS value FROM SAC_TEST_DB.SAC_CONFORMANCE.SAC_METRICS

Q08_unique_customers.sql: SELECT AGG(unique_customers) AS value FROM SAC_TEST_DB.SAC_CONFORMANCE.SAC_METRICS

Q09_completed_revenue_by_warehouse.sql: SELECT warehouse_id, AGG(revenue) AS value FROM SAC_TEST_DB.SAC_CONFORMANCE.SAC_METRICS GROUP BY warehouse_id ORDER BY warehouse_id

Q10_nonadditive_rollup_check.sql: SELECT order_date, AGG(fill_rate) AS daily_fill_rate FROM SAC_TEST_DB.SAC_CONFORMANCE.SAC_METRICS WHERE order_status='Completed' GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY order_date
